Independently visually verified for gemma-vision-v1 before inspecting vision predictions. Existing item names, counts, quantities, unit prices, pre-discount gross values, signed discounts, post-discount totals, deposits and document amounts were checked against source image(s). No numerical corrections required. Assistant verification is not human gold.

All item money fields are gross amounts in PLN. Item total is after the signed discount; before_discount is quantity times unit_price rounded to cents. tax_summary.sales is gross taxable turnover, not a net amount. No unprinted net amounts were invented.

Only the upper main receipt is annotated. A different receipt partly visible below is excluded.
